description: This Java class, HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler, handles MQTT 5 subscriptions in the Eclipse Ditto project. It extends an abstract subscription handler and provides logic to convert Source objects into MQTT subscription requests, managing MQTT subscription lifecycle.

classes.name: HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: A final class that manages MQTT 5 subscriptions using HiveMQ's client library within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It converts source addresses into MQTT subscriptions and manages subscription lifecycle.

methods.name: HiveMqtt5SubscriptionHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing the handler with connection, MQTT client, and logger.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Converts a Source object into an MQTT subscribe message, building subscription requests for each address.

methods.name: toMqttSubscribe
methods.description: Creates an optional MQTT subscribe message from the given Source object by mapping addresses to MQTT subscriptions.
